remarks: A well-appointed three-bedroom, two full-bathroom home located in the heart of Westover. The layout is designed for comfortable living, offering an open floor plan with single level living and plenty of space, a key feature of this property is its setting, the backyard is not just a standard plot; it directly borders a gentle stream. This provides a consistent, tranquil backdrop of natural sounds and a sense of privacy you don't always find. You can expect to see local wildlife and enjoy a view that changes with the seasons. The combination of the modern conveniences of a three-bedroom home with the added benefit of a natural water feature makes it a unique offering in the area. This is the perfect home for someone looking for a peaceful retreat while still being close to all the amenities and commute options that Stamford provides. Additional notable features which includes two electric car charging ports installed at front of driveway. Don't forget to setup your tour today as this one will not last long!!!
